description: This file defines the HelpTopicSection class, a Drupal plugin that provides a help topics list section for the help page, including methods for listing, rendering, and caching help topics.

classes.name: HelpTopicSection
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a help topics list section for the help page, managing help topic plugins, caching, and rendering for search.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for HelpTopicSection, initializing dependencies and parent class.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the help section, based on cache metadata.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts for the help section, based on cache metadata.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age for the help section, based on cache metadata.

methods.name: listTopics
methods.description: Lists top-level help topics as links.

methods.name: getPlugins
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts top-level help topic plugins.

methods.name: listSearchableTopics
methods.description: Returns list of searchable topic IDs.

methods.name: renderTopicForSearch
methods.description: Renders a help topic for search indexing in a specified language.

methods.name: getCacheMetadata
methods.description: Provides merged cache metadata for all top-level help topic plugins.
